import os, json, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,'crty_lib.py')).read(), globals())
allseq=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,'lycopene_cyclase_homologs.json')))
q=allseq['P21687']['seq']; L=len(q)
cb=np.load(os.path.join(OUT,'conservation_bacteria.npy')); ce=np.load(os.path.join(OUT,'conservation_eukaryote.npy'))
D=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'crtY_residue_membrane_depth.csv'))
fit=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,'crtY_membrane_fit.json')))
hel=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,'crtY_cavities.json')))
cav=hel['0.85'][0]; lining=set(cav['lining'])

# coverage: how many bacterial homologues actually have residues aligned past 350?
bac=[d for d in allseq.values() if not (d['lineage'] and d['lineage'][0]=='Eukaryota') and 320<=d['length']<=500]
lens=np.array([d['length'] for d in bac])
print("bacterial CrtY-like homologues n=%d, length median %d (IQR %d-%d); fraction >=375 aa: %.2f"%(
    len(lens),np.median(lens),np.percentile(lens,25),np.percentile(lens,75),(lens>=375).mean()))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,3,height_ratios=[1,1,1.2],hspace=.55,wspace=.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.fill_between(D.resi,0,D.depth.clip(lower=0),color='#c0392b',alpha=.75,label='inside fitted membrane')
ax.plot(D.resi,D.depth,lw=.7,color='#34495e')
ax.axhline(0,color='k',lw=.8)
ax.set_ylabel('depth below fitted\nmembrane surface (A)')
ax.set_xlabel('residue')
for a,b,lab,c in [(6,36,'FAD motif','#2980b9'),(309,352,'309-352','#16a085'),(353,382,'353-382','#8e44ad')]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=.12)
    ax.text((a+b)/2,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.85,lab,ha='center',fontsize=8,color=c)
ax.scatter([199],[D.loc[D.resi==199,'depth']],color='k',zorder=5)
ax.annotate('Glu199',(199,float(D.loc[D.resi==199,'depth'].iloc[0])),xytext=(205,-30),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-',lw=.7))
ax.set_title('Only residues 309-382 reach the optimal membrane plane; the catalytic Glu199 sits 17.8 A outside it',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
w=9; k=np.ones(w)/w
ax.plot(np.arange(1,L+1),np.convolve(cb,k,'same'),color='#2c3e50',label='55 bacterial lycopene cyclases')
ax.plot(np.arange(1,L+1),np.convolve(ce,k,'same'),color='#e67e22',label='30 eukaryotic (plant/fungal) cyclases')
ax.axhline(cb.mean(),ls='--',lw=.8,color='#2c3e50'); ax.axhline(ce.mean(),ls='--',lw=.8,color='#e67e22')
for a,b,c in [(331,338,'#16a085'),(353,382,'#8e44ad')]: ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=.15)
ax.set_xlabel('residue of P21687'); ax.set_ylabel('identity fraction\n(9-residue mean)')
ax.set_title('Conservation: the 331-338 amphipathic helix is above average, the 353-382 insertion element is not',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
s='WRVMQRFY'; start=331
ang=np.radians(100*np.arange(len(s)))
xs,ys=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
for i,(x,y,c) in enumerate(zip(xs,ys,s)):
    col='#c0392b' if EISENBERG[c]>0.2 else ('#2980b9' if c in 'KR' else '#7f8c8d')
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=520,color=col,alpha=.85,zorder=3)
    ax.text(x,y,'%s%d'%(c,start+i),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7,color='w',zorder=4)
ax.plot(np.r_[xs,xs[0]][: len(s)],np.r_[ys,ys[0]][:len(s)],color='k',lw=.6,zorder=1)
mu,h=hyd_moment(s)
ax.set_title('Helix 331-338 wheel\nmuH=%.2f  <H>=%.2f'%(mu,h),fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-1.6,1.6); ax.set_ylim(-1.6,1.6); ax.set_aspect(1); ax.axis('off')

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
bench=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'membrane_docking_benchmark.csv'))
cmap={'monotopic, lipophilic substrate':'#c0392b','soluble FAD Rossmann':'#2980b9',
      'FAD Rossmann, membrane-bound (C-term TM helix)':'#8e44ad','query (AlphaFold model)':'#27ae60',
      'query (deletion control)':'#7f8c8d'}
ax.barh(range(len(bench)),bench.dG_per_1000A2,color=[cmap[k] for k in bench.klass])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(bench))); ax.set_yticklabels(bench.pdb,fontsize=7); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel('transfer energy per 1000 A2 (kcal/mol)',fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Docking score does not cleanly separate\nmonotopic from soluble controls',fontsize=9)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,2])
sel=D[(D.resi>=300)]
ax.scatter(sel.plddt,sel.depth,c=np.where(sel.resi>=353,'#8e44ad','#16a085'),s=18)
ax.axhline(0,color='k',lw=.7); ax.set_xlabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylabel('membrane depth (A)')
ax.set_title('The deepest-inserting residues are\nthe lowest-confidence ones (353-382)',fontsize=9)
plt.suptitle('CrtY (P21687) AlphaFold model: candidate monotopic membrane-docking elements',fontsize=12)
plt.show()

print("\nActive-site cavity (vol %.0f A3) lining residues drawn from the C-terminal helical region:"%cav['vol'],
      sorted(x for x in lining if x>=300))
print("cavity depth span relative to membrane surface: %.1f to %.1f A"%(cav['mindepth'],cav['maxdepth']))
print("gap between the membrane-proximal end of the cavity and the bilayer surface: %.1f A"%(-cav['maxdepth']))
top=D[(D.resi>=309)].sort_values('depth',ascending=False).head(20)
print("\nmost deeply inserting residues:", ', '.join('%s%d(%.1fA)'%(a,r,d) for a,r,d in zip(top.aa,top.resi,top.depth)))
print("\nbasic residues at the interface (depth>0):", ', '.join('%s%d(%.1fA)'%(a,r,d) for a,r,d in zip(D.aa,D.resi,D.depth) if a in 'KR' and d>0))
